description.zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

> 多个IP地址需要用英文逗号隔开，所有IP白名单累积支持添加1000个IP地址或地址段。
description.en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

> Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). You can create up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks for all IP address whitelists.
The name of the IP whitelist template.
The ID of the IP whitelist template.
The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-global-security-ip-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name dps --global-security-group-id g-fwjk62egbsrp4sftxmmr --gip-list 27.16.214.10,111.60.117.181 --region cn-hangzhou
